method: Flesch-Kincaid estimated age = 0.39 * words / sentence_units + 11.8 * syllables / words - 15.59 + 5. Each punctuated sentence or standalone line is a sentence unit. Same fixed vowel-group heuristic and overrides as the exemplar. These are text estimates, not learner assessments. Staff notes, running headers/footers and document locators are excluded. Pupil page headings, diagram labels, definitions and answer-reveal text are included. File-name stems are counted as alphabetic word groups.

rules: Lowercase; strip possessive apostrophe s and remaining apostrophes.
Subtract final silent e unless consonant-le ending, when count exceeds one.
Subtract final ed except ted or ded, when count exceeds one.

surfaces.label: pupil_page_3
surfaces.text:
Knowledge organiser
The aim
I can compare sources and use evidence to explain a choice.
Four checks
Who made it? When was it made or checked? Why was it made? What evidence is shown?
Compare
Do two sources give separate evidence? Two copies of one claim are not two checks.
Keep a limit
A neat page or a new date does not prove a claim. A source may help with one question but not another.
My success checks
[ ] I compared who, when, purpose and evidence.
[ ] I used two source letters and details for my choice.
[ ] I named one thing I still need to check.
[ ] I saved and reopened my own work.
Where this leads
Before an application, check role and training details against current evidence so your choices are well informed.

Staff observer | 14 November 2026
Purpose: To record what happened.
Three taster sessions took 29, 30 and 31 minutes. All kit was loaned at each session. The notes cover these three sessions only.
Evidence: Records three timings and kit use.
Keep it fictional
